user_need_match.quote: auto-done: worker idle + 100% todos, claude exited without invoking worker-mark-done.sh
user_need_match.evidence: The auto-done feature does not exist anywhere in the codebase. (1) patrol.rs:193 guards file-based stall detection with `todos_completed < progress.todos_total` — the >= branch for 100% completion is entirely absent. (2) `detect_idle_prompt` in oracle_lifecycle.rs:704 is a private fn — cannot be called by patrol even if the branch were added. (3) DoneSignal struct (done.rs:7-20) has no `written_by` field — close-gate.sh provenance validation cannot accept patrol-written signals. (4) Grepping all 6 scoped files (forwarder.rs, main.rs, session.rs, app.rs, input.rs, ui.rs) for auto_done, AutoDone, todos_completed, mark_done returns 0 matches — the recent TUI mission added NO auto-done logic.

issues_found_and_fixed.issue: Auto-done: no code path for todos_completed >= todos_total && !has_done && idle_prompt. Workers that complete 100% of todos and Claude exits naturally are never marked done_clean — oracle inbox never receives worker_done event — mission hangs indefinitely.
detect_idle_prompt is private fn — the patrol auto-done branch cannot call it without making it pub or duplicating the idle-prompt detection logic.
close-gate.sh validates written_by=worker-mark-done.sh. Auto-done written by patrol must either set this field or close-gate.sh must accept written_by=patrol.
DoneSignal struct has no written_by field. close-gate.sh compatibility requires it.
